scripts.text: SELECT CALLLISTRULE_IID FROM PDS_CALLLISTRULE WHERE CALLLISTRULE_CD = @0

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT @LAST_LOAD_DATE_INT = DATE_KEY ,CAST('REMOVE' as VARCHAR) AS ADD_REMOVE,@{pipeline().parameters.CALLLISTRULE_IID} AS CALLLISTRULE_IID FROM CAREADVANCE_DM.APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_DATE WHERE DATE = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(DATE,@LAST_LOAD_DTM)) SELECT @LAST_LOAD_TIME_INT = TIME_KEY FROM CAREADVANCE_DM.APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_TIME WHERE TIME = CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(TIME,@LAST_LOAD_DTM)) DECLARE @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_STATECHOICE TABLE (FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY INT) INSERT INTO @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_STATECHOICE (FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY) SELECT DFCC.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY FROM [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG DFCC INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_CONCEPT DC ON DFCC.CONCEPT_KEY = DC.CONCEPT_KEY AND DC.CONCEPT_ID = 581452 DECLARE @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_CHANGECHOICE TABLE (FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY INT) INSERT INTO @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_CHANGECHOICE (FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY) SELECT DFCC.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY FROM [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG DFCC INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_CONCEPT DC ON DFCC.CONCEPT_KEY = DC.CONCEPT_KEY AND DC.CONCEPT_ID = 581453 SELECT DM.SUBSCRIBER_ID + '00' AS MEMBERNUMBER,FMFC_S.ANSWER AS STATECHOICEANSWER,FMFC_C.ANSWER AS CHANGECHOICEANSWER FROM [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_FORM] DF INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM] FMF ON FMF.FORM_KEY = DF.FORM_KEY AND DF.FORM_ID = '501201' AND ( FMF.CREATE_DATE>@LAST_LOAD_DATE_INT OR (FMF.CREATE_DATE=@LAST_LOAD_DATE_INT AND FMF.CREATE_TIME>@LAST_LOAD_TIME_INT) ) INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM_CONCEPT] FMFC_S ON FMF.MEMBER_FORM_KEY = FMFC_S.MEMBER_FORM_KEY INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG DFCC_S ON DFCC_S.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY = FMFC_S.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_CONCEPT DC_S ON DFCC_S.CONCEPT_KEY = DC_S.CONCEPT_KEY AND FMFC_S.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY IN (SELECT FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY FROM @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_STATECHOICE) INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].[DW_FACT_MEMBER_FORM_CONCEPT] FMFC_C ON FMF.MEMBER_FORM_KEY = FMFC_C.MEMBER_FORM_KEY INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG DFCC_C ON DFCC_C.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY = FMFC_C.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_CONCEPT DC_C ON DFCC_C.CONCEPT_KEY = DC_C.CONCEPT_KEY AND FMFC_C.FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY IN (SELECT FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_KEY FROM @TMP_FORM_CONCEPT_CONFIG_CHANGECHOICE) INNER JOIN [APP_CAEDM].DW_DIM_MEMBER DM ON FMF.MEME_CK = DM.MEME_CK WHERE DC_S.OPTION_VALUE = 'YES'

scripts.text:
DECLARE @CALLLISTRULE_IID BIGINT = @CALLLISTRULE_IID
DECLARE @CALLLIST_336_IID BIGINT
DECLARE @CALLLIST_137_IID BIGINT

SELECT @CALLLIST_336_IID = CALLLIST_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST WHERE CALLLIST_CD = '336'
SELECT @CALLLIST_137_IID = CALLLIST_IID FROM PDS_CALLLIST WHERE CALLLIST_CD = '137'

UPDATE S 
SET CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING S 
	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON S.CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER
WHERE CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLISTRULE_IID = @CALLLISTRULE_IID

UPDATE PDS_CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING SET CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLIST_IID = @CALLLIST_336_IID WHERE CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLISTRULE_IID = @CALLLISTRULE_IID

INSERT INTO PDS_CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING (CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLIST_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLISTRULE_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBER_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_ADD_REMOVE)
SELECT @CALLLIST_137_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLISTRULE_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBER_IID,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER,CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_ADD_REMOVE
FROM PDS_CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING
WHERE CALLLIST_MEMBER_STAGING_CALLLISTRULE_IID = @CALLLISTRULE_IID
